Detroit Lions v New England Patriots (Kick-off 2.30pm). Coverage of the week 10 match from Allianz Arena in Munich, Germany. This is only the third international series game that the Lions have appeared in, having previously beat the Atlanta Falcons 22-21 in 2014 but lost to the Kansas City Chiefs 45-10 one year later, both at Wembley Stadium. The Patriots have greater experience of playing abroad and boast a 4-0 record, and most recently won 10-6 against the Indianapolis Colts in Frankfurt three years ago.
